intro.title: Find All Anagrams in a String
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that finds all starting indices of anagrams of a given pattern string within a larger text string. You will learn to use the sliding window technique, a core algorithm concept for efficiently comparing substrings. The implementation will involve JavaScript arrays, objects for frequency counting, and string manipulation. By the end, you'll understand how to track character frequencies and validate anagrams in linear time.
intro.usecase: The 'Find All Anagrams in a String' algorithm is essential in text analysis and search features of real-world applications. For example, in a word processor or document editor, it powers the 'find similar words' or anagram detection tool within a search panel, helping users locate variations of a term. It's also used in data validation for password strength checkers to flag passwords that are anagrams of common words, enhancing security in user registration forms. Additionally, bioinformatics software employs this pattern in DNA sequence analysis dashboards to identify genetic pattern repetitions, aiding in medical research.
